faq_heading: New Listings This Week in Langley: your questions answered

faq.q: How many homes sold in Langley last month?
faq.a: In October 2026, 59 detached homes and 136 condos and townhomes sold in Langley (SnapStats).

faq.q: How many months of supply does Langley have?
faq.a: About 7.5 months for detached homes and 4.9 months for condos and townhomes in October 2026, measured as homes for sale divided by homes sold in the month.

faq.q: What was the busiest month for Langley home sales this past year?
faq.a: For detached homes it was May 2026, with 90 sales; the quietest was January 2026, with 40.

faq.q: Which Langley price range sells fastest?
faq.a: For detached homes, $1,000,001 to $1,250,000, with a 28% sales ratio on 20 sales in October 2026.

blocks.text: New listings in Langley come on the MLS® every day. This search shows the ones that have been on the market 7 days or less, live. To judge a fresh listing, it helps to know how quickly the market is clearing: in October 2026, 59 detached homes and 136 condos and townhomes sold in Langley, and the typical detached home sold in 21 days.
How fast Langley homes sold over the past year

Detached sales in Langley peaked at 90 in May 2026 and were lowest at 40 in January 2026. Active detached listings moved between 314 and 486 over the same 13 months. In October 2026 the median detached sale price was $1,300,000, which is 6% below October 2025.

blocks.text: How long a new Langley listing may sit

Months of supply is the number of months it would take to sell today's listings at the current pace. For Langley detached homes it was 7.5 months in October 2026 and for condos and townhomes 4.9. The fastest detached price ranges were $1,000,001 to $1,250,000 (28% sales ratio on 20 sales); $1,250,001 to $1,500,000 (22% sales ratio on 20 sales); $1,500,001 to $1,750,000 (6% sales ratio on 5 sales). For condos and townhomes the quickest were $700,001 to $800,000 (37%) and $300,001 to $400,000 (25%).

By area, new detached listings met the strongest demand in Walnut Grove (32%), Aldergrove (17%), Willoughby Heights (15%). The areas with the most stock relative to sales were Langley City (7%), Salmon River (7%), Murrayville (8%), so a fresh listing there is likely to have company.

Compared with October 2025, October 2026 had 7% fewer detached homes for sale in Langley and 25% fewer detached sales. Condos and townhomes had 21% fewer for sale and 7% fewer sales. The detached sale price moved 6% down and the condo and townhome price 3% down.
